references.text: The fulfillment of Rahab's prayer: her family was saved when Jericho fell, just as the spies had promised.
Lot also had the opportunity to save his family from the destruction of Sodom, in a similar way that Rahab asked for her family to be saved.
Hebrews mentions Rahab's faith as the reason she and her family were saved from destruction.
James refers to Rahab as an example of justification by works when she welcomed the spies and sent them away by another route.
Abraham asked his wife to say that she was his sister to save his life, a theme about preserving the family's lives.
The spies give Rahab instructions on how she and her family will be saved when the Israelites attack.
